3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:304b8c9b-1b4c.title: BCBA Practice Owner - Launch and Grow your practice
3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:304b8c9b-1b4c.description: Launch and Grow Your Own ABA Practice — with Zero Upfront Costs Join 3Y Health and earn $100,000 - $320,000/year while making your own schedule. Tired of rigid clinical environments and professional burnout? Looking to build a practice and don’t know where to start? At 3Y Health, we believe BCBAs deserve more — more freedom, more support, and more impact. That’s why we’ve created a platform where you can launch and grow your own ABA practice with no upfront costs and full operational support. We handle the logistics. You focus on care. For more information, please visit: https://3yhealth.com/specialties/autism-therapy-aba What Makes 3Y Health Different? - $0 upfront to join — No fees, no hidden costs. - Earn up to $320,000/year based on your client caseload and schedule. - Concierge assistance with LLC creation, business banking, and liability insurance. - Total flexibility — You choose your hours, clients, and care model. - World-class support — We take care of operations so you can focus on clinical outcomes. - Custom referral support to help you build your preferred caseload. What We Provide: - All-in-one software suite – Includes Practice Management, Scheduling, EHR, Data Collection, Billing, Onboarding, and mobile apps for you, your RBTs, and your clients. - Insurance partnerships – We’re in-network with 100+ payers at high market rates, giving you broad access to patients. - Practice launch support – We’ll help you start your own ABA company if you don’t already have one. - Fast payments – Get paid upfront per session. No more chasing down insurance. - Payroll made easy – We’ll run payroll for you and your RBTs if you’d like. Your Role: - Own and operate your practice – Set your hours, select clients, and define how you deliver care. - Hire and lead your RBTs – Build a team that aligns with your vision. - Deliver exceptional ABA therapy – You’re the expert. We give you the platform to thrive. Why BCBAs Love 3Y Health: - 100% autonomy with zero admin headaches - Real earning potential with no financial risk - Flexible work-from-anywhere model - Make a bigger impact without burning out

locations: 5120 Peters Creek Rd NW, Roanoke, VA 24019
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:a90.description: For over two decades, MotoSport has led the powersports industry with unmatched selection, quality, and expertise. Since our founding in 1999, we’ve been driven by one mission — to make your next ride your best ride. As a premier powersports retail e-commerce company, we’re dedicated to providing riders of all types with high-quality parts, gear, and accessories from the most trusted brands. When you reach out to us, you’re not just talking to a salesperson — you’re connecting with someone who rides, wrenches, and lives the lifestyle. We are committed to providing the highest level of service in the powersports industry. For us, that means having an enthusiastic Motorcycle Set Up Technician & Driver / Dealership Lot Attendant on staff. This person is passionate about the industry, eager to grow their career, and ready and waiting to consistently deliver upon that commitment. Reports to: Service Manager, Location: Roanoke, VA
responsibilities: Uncrate and set up new units upon delivery
Perform pre-delivery inspections, routine tire changes, basic maintenance, and minor accessory installations
Responsible for overall general housekeeping inside and outside the dealership
Responsible for product cleanliness and detailing; both new and pre-owned

Ability to assist in moving product from one location to another, i.e.; to and from Service, to and from Sales Department; as well as to and from our warehouse in Christiansburg and/or other off-site location
Ability to pick up and deliver various items including but not limited to customer product.
Able to work under close supervision of the Service and Sales Manager.
Abide by all dealership policies pertaining to the department.
Follow company dress codes and be well groomed at all times.
Any other specific duties deemed necessary for the overall success of the department and the dealership as a whole.
Maintain a positive working relationship with all other employees.
qualifications: Basic knowledge of at least one of the rider segments that we sell to/storefronts (Dirt, Street, ATV, Utility ATV, UTV, Cruiser)
Strong ability to multitask and prioritize workload
Proactive mindset and creative problem solving skills
Clean driving record with a valid driver’s license
Ability and willingness to obtain motorcycle endorsement

Ability to use or learn electronic platforms such as laptops, desktops, smart phones, tablets etc.  These will be used for things such as industry software, timekeeping (ADP), Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Exchange etc.), Outlook (email and calendar) and Google suite (Drive, Sheets, Documents, etc.)

distro-distro:lever:cb293ef8-12c1-46d7-b.description: 🌟 Human Resources Director 📍 Reports to: County Commissioners 🕒 Status: Full-Time \u007C Non-Exempt \u007C Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM 💰 Salary Range: $82,947 - $131,109 annually 📍Primarily Onsite (Hybrid may be considered for the right candidate) Job Summary: Under general direction, the Human Resources Director is responsible for overseeing all Human Resource functions within the County, ensuring compliance with HR requirements, managing recruitment and hiring processes, administering benefits and wage programs, fostering employee relations, conducting investigations into employee grievances and complaints, and coordinating safety and injury response initiatives. This leadership role requires strategic thinking, interpretive judgment and extensive knowledge of HR processes within established standards and procedures. A hybrid work schedule may be negotiated. Essential Duties, Responsibilities and Expectations: Compliance: Maintain accurate and up-to-date personnel files and HRIS system information for current and past employees. Manage confidential notification and scheduling of drug and alcohol testing, maintaining separate files for each employee. Ensure job descriptions, salary ranges, and the County Handbook and policies are updated according to employment law. Administer Drug and Alcohol Testing Programs and maintain compliance with safety, discrimination, workers' compensation, and prevailing wage requirements. Assist Elected Officials and Department Heads with compliance and federal/state/county posting requirements. Recruitment and Hiring: Recruit, interview, and facilitate the hiring of qualified applicants in collaboration with Elected Officials and Department Heads. Conduct background checks, pre-employment drug testing, and eligibility verifications. Communicate with applicants regarding their application status. Coordinate and facilitate new employee orientation. Benefits and Wage Administration: Collaborate on payroll processes as needed and offboard employees from benefit systems. Prepare annual salary/benefit estimates for the Board of Commissioners. Monitor continuing education programs and certifications. Employee Relations, Retention, and Off-Boarding: Advise employees on benefits and handle employment-related inquiries. Oversee employee performance evaluations. Assist departments with personnel functions and provide management training. Recommend employee recognition and wellness programs. Cultivate a healthy, cohesive, inclusive, and supportive workplace culture. Review and investigate grievances and employee complaints. Document, attend, and provide advice in disciplinary meetings and terminations. Administer offboarding processes for terminated employees and maintain employee retention programs. Prepare reports and maintain frequent contact with staff and the public. Conduct labor negotiations and review Unfair Labor Practice claims and grievances. Safety and Injury Response: Develop policies for injury prevention, follow-up, and workers' compensation compliance. Review accident and hazard reports, ensuring appropriate follow-up actions are taken. Supervision: Supervise an administrative assistant. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Requires frequent contact with the public and fellow employees where tact, diplomacy, and confidentiality are essential. Knowledge of County policies and agreements is required. Knowledge of labor negotiations and business practices as they related to the public sector. Strong organizational skills with the ability to maintain complex records and prioritize competing tasks. Thorough knowledge of principles and practices of personnel management. Ability to analyze and resolve personnel management problems. Ability to negotiate and resolve conflicts effectively. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with a strong commitment to public service. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and County software systems. jobgether-jobgether:lever:b2853a31-732e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Backend Software Developer based in United States. This is an opportunity to build backend software that powers a new generation of electric-vehicle customer experiences. You will take ownership across the full development lifecycle, from architecture and system design through implementation, testing, and operations. The role combines hands-on engineering with significant influence over technical direction and long-term technology decisions. You will work closely with product and UX teams to create scalable, customer-focused digital experiences in a fast-moving startup environment. Your decisions will have direct visibility and impact, requiring strong technical judgment alongside an understanding of business priorities. You will also contribute to engineering excellence through code and design reviews, mentoring, and raising development standards across the organization. This role is well suited to an experienced backend engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, simplifying systems, and building products where individual contributions matter. Lead the definition, architecture, design, implementation, testing, and delivery of backend software and supporting systems. Develop high-quality, maintainable code and take ownership of system components throughout their lifecycle. Design and implement scalable, reliable backend architectures that support evolving digital customer experiences. Lead and participate in code reviews and technical design reviews, establishing high engineering standards across the development process. Own end-to-end code quality, including system testing, functional testing, integration testing, and operational readiness. Apply creativity, sound judgment, and a strong bias toward simplification when solving complex technical and product challenges. Collaborate closely with UX, product, and other technical teams to define and deliver innovative customer-focused applications. Act as a trusted technical authority, providing guidance on complex engineering issues and helping teams navigate difficult technical trade-offs. Evaluate the business impact of technology decisions and balance short-term delivery needs with long-term reliability, scalability, and maintainability. Drive awareness of technical risks, dependencies, and consequences across technical and business stakeholders. Contribute to decisions around technology selection, architecture, design patterns, reliability, and system scaling. Mentor engineers and support the professional development of individuals and the broader engineering community. Help managers and technical leaders identify development opportunities and support career growth across the team. Operate effectively in an environment characterized by rapid change, ambiguity, competing priorities, and high ownership. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience. At least 6 years of professional software development experience. At least 6 years of programming experience with one or more modern languages such as TypeScript, Python, Java, or comparable technologies. At least 6 years of experience working with cloud services, particularly AWS and/or Azure. At least 4 years of experience contributing to the architecture and design of new and existing systems, including architecture patterns, reliability, scalability, and maintainability. At least 4 years of experience across the full software development lifecycle, including coding standards, source control, code reviews, build processes, testing, deployment, and operations. Strong backend engineering fundamentals and the ability to design and deliver production-grade systems. jobgether-jobgether:lever:be16613c-89ef-.title: Staff QA Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:be16613c-89ef-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff QA Engineer I based in Brazil. As a Staff QA Engineer I, you will play a strategic role in shaping software quality across engineering teams. You will combine advanced manual and automated testing expertise with emerging AI and agentic testing technologies. The role focuses on building scalable quality strategies, improving test coverage, and increasing engineering efficiency through intelligent automation. You will design and govern AI-assisted testing workflows, including MCP-based solutions, while establishing standards for safe and reliable adoption. Working closely with Engineering, Product, Platform, and MLOps teams, you will influence quality practices across the software development lifecycle. You will also mentor engineers and communicate technical risks and quality insights to senior stakeholders. This is an opportunity to make a broad impact in a global, collaborative, and innovation-driven environment. Lead the adoption and operationalization of AI across quality assurance teams, designing AI-enhanced testing workflows and measuring their impact through measurable quality and efficiency outcomes. Define standards for safe and reliable AI usage within test pipelines, regression systems, validation workflows, and automated quality processes. Design and govern agentic testing workflows using Model Context Protocol (MCP) technologies such as Maestro MCP and Playwright MCP across multiple teams. Evaluate emerging AI and agentic testing technologies and lead root-cause analysis for false positives, regression drift, unstable automation, and other quality issues. Partner with MLOps, Platform, Product, and Engineering teams to establish evaluation standards, production-quality baselines, and scalable validation strategies. Design advanced test strategies, test plans, and machine-readable test cases that enable AI-assisted test generation and improve coverage for new features and complex changes. Establish and continuously improve QA methodologies, automation frameworks, and technical standards that raise quality practices across Engineering. Collaborate with Product and Engineering leaders to refine requirements, identify quality risks, and ensure comprehensive coverage throughout the software development lifecycle. Mentor QA and engineering professionals in advanced testing techniques, AI-assisted quality practices, and scalable automation approaches. Communicate testing outcomes, quality insights, technical risks, and recommendations clearly to engineering leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. Promote reusable AI operational assets such as prompt libraries, validation checklists, triage runbooks, and agentic testing playbooks. Requirements: 8+ years of experience in Quality Assurance Engineering, with strong experience across both manual and automated testing. Proficiency with automated testing frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, TestNG, or JUnit. Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitLab or CircleCI. Demonstrated experience operationalizing AI-assisted and agentic testing workflows at team or organizational level, including validation standards, human-in-the-loop boundaries, and measurable AI ROI. Hands-on experience with AI-assisted testing and MCP-based test generation or execution, particularly technologies such as Maestro MCP and Playwright MCP. Strong judgment regarding AI-generated testing output, including when results can be trusted and when additional validation is required. Experience with bug tracking and test management tools such as Jira and TestRail. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Proven ability to improve team efficiency, testing quality, or engineering output through strategic use of AI and automation. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills. superiorexecutiveandlegalrecruiting-supe.description: Plaintiff-side law firm located in Burbank seeks an Administrative Coordinator. This position is for someone who possesses strong organizational skills and has a great attitude. The day-to-day duties will include: supporting the intake team, handling incoming/outgoing mail correspondence, handling incoming/outgoing faxes, responding to emails, submitting and receiving documents via DocuSign, and various other administrative responsibilities. Candidates should have a Bachelor's degree and a strong knowledge of Microsoft Office. Some legal experience is preferred but not required. All resumes will be treated with the strictest of confidence.
